title: Skips on the Existing Tailwise Autoship and a New Pet's Shipment Spacing
content:
Customer-requested skips on the existing Autoship lengthen the days between shipments of a second pet's own Autoship Everyday subscription under Tailwise Autoship (opened for an item the household already receives on another pet's Autoship).

| Skips the customer requested on the existing Autoship in the last six months | Days added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 14 |
| exactly 1 | 7 |
| none | none |

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

Automatic backorder skips are not customer-requested and do not count.

**Hypothetical record.** Customer skips seven and three months ago: one in the period, 7 days added.
